_about: Colour statistics of reference gameplay frames of the genre this game imitates. The frames themselves are copyrighted and are not in the repository; these derived numbers are the art-direction target. Tolerances are deliberately wide: the goal is to read as the same genre, not to copy a frame.
_source: Wikipedia (en) file Battling_in_fortnite.jpg, HUD regions excluded; measured by tests/stylemetrics.cjs
